developer: Bangladesh Agriculture Research Institute (BARI), Gazipur, Bangladesh
main_characteristics: Plant height medium; intermediate type; canopy habit semi determinate; growth habit semi-erect; absent or very few branching; thickness of main stem medium; extension of anthocyanin coloration of stem strong. Tuber shape round (compress); tuber size medium; depth of eyes medium; smoothness of tuber skin rough; color of tuber skin red; color of base of eye red; color of flesh light yellow; eye distribution predominantly; uniformity of tuber high. crop duration 90-95 days
source_org: BARI, via BSMRAU Digital Herbarium of Crop Plants
